note: Registry of character master sheets. An asset is official ONLY when status is 'approved'. Only the project owner may set 'approved'. 'assets' lists files that exist on disk; empty means nothing is uploaded/registered yet. 'planned_sheets' are owner-declared intentions, NOT files and NOT assets. Brand assets (logos, supporting visuals) are tracked separately under 'brand_assets' and never count toward the character gate.

summary: LYLA and LYLA-Education are two different projects.
LYLA = LYLA Marvely and general LYLA brand content.
LYLA-Education = all educational content, educational mascots, worksheets and educational series.
Sheets titled 'Maskot LYLA Education' (Lyla solo, Lyla & Lilo) belong in LYLA-Education.
Aisyah and Mama Aisyah belong in LYLA-Education (educational series about child behavior and parenting).
Rico-and-Friends official characters: Rico, Lila, Bimo, Tika, Piko. Pip and Moss are NOT official. Do not create replacement characters or alter existing designs.
Project/dinosaur name spelling is 'Rico' (the sheet images may read 'Riko'; do not edit the images).

Arsein-Research stores ALL brand visual assets (master character sheet, primary logo, alternate logos, supporting assets); logos/brand assets are recorded separately from master characters. Do not alter original designs or create new assets.
Logos inside a master character sheet stay part of that sheet; they are not extracted as logo files.
